The maker behind Make It Matter

👋🏻 I'm Andie and I've always loved crafting, from making paper cards with my grandmother and picking pins off her sewing room floor, to sewing my own clothes, crocheting blankets, and dabbling in woodworking.

During some recent time off, I started exploring charity crafting as a way to keep making and learning while giving back to the community. I discovered so many great organisations along the way and built this tool to share what I found. I hope it inspires your own crafting journey! The directory is still growing so if there's a project you'd like to try or an organisation you want to promote, just reach out.
